format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: Запись открыта до 30 ноября. Правила записи

probes.title: disclosure: the trigger is a button named by the label with aria-expanded and aria-controls; it opens the panel in place, Escape closes it and gives the focus back
probes.covers: settings.label, settings.layout disclosure, settings.open, keyboard.host, accessibility

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#disclosure'); const b = el.querySelector('.sf-display-settings__trigger button'); const panel = el.querySelector('.sf-display-settings__panel'); return b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Версия для слабовидящих' && b.textContent.includes('Версия для слабовидящих') && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && b.getAttribute('aria-controls') === panel.id && panel.hidden && !el.hasAttribute('data-open'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#disclosure'); const b = el.querySelector('.sf-display-settings__trigger button'); const panel = el.querySelector('.sf-display-settings__panel'); return b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && !panel.hidden && el.open === true && el.hasAttribute('data-open') && panel.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Версия для слабовидящих'; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#disclosure'); return el.open === false && el.querySelector('.sf-display-settings__panel').hidden && el.contains(document.activeElement); })()

probes.title: a scheme is a pressed toggle in the group «Цвет»; the root takes data-sf-scheme, the page its ground and text, links are underlined; the choice is in localStorage and in no cookie

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.documentElement; const b = document.querySelector("#plain button[data-value='yellow-on-black']"); const group = b.closest('[role=group][data-group=scheme]'); const label = document.getElementById(group.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const kept = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sf-display-settings') || '{}'); return root.getAttribute('data-sf-scheme') === 'yellow-on-black' && b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && label.textContent === 'Цвет' && kept.scheme === 'yellow-on-black' && document.cookie === window.__cookie && getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#link')).textDecorationLine === 'underline' && getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor === 'rgb(0, 0, 0)' && window.__changes.join() === 'scheme' && document.querySelector('#panel').settings.scheme === 'yellow-on-black'; })()

probes.title: «А+» twice: the root is 150 % of the browser's size and says so in a live region; «Обычная версия» takes everything back and forgets the choice

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.documentElement; const value = document.querySelector('#plain .sf-display-settings__value'); return root.getAttribute('data-sf-text-scale') === '150' && Math.abs(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).fontSize) - window.__base * 1.5) < 0.5 && value.textContent.trim() === '150 %' && value.getAttribute('aria-live') === 'polite'; })()

probes.title: the font and links groups only where the author turns them on; images hidden leave the text alternative in place

steps.check: (() => { const has = (id, g) => Boolean(document.querySelector(`#${id} [data-group=${g}]`)); return has('panel', 'font') && has('panel', 'links') && !has('plain', 'font') && !has('plain', 'links'); })()

(() => { const pic = document.querySelector('#pic'); const caption = pic.nextElementSibling; return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-sf-images') === 'hide' && getComputedStyle(pic).display === 'none' && caption.classList.contains('sf-image-caption') && caption.textContent === 'Читальный зал после ремонта' && getComputedStyle(caption).display === 'block'; })()
